name: ai-bridge
description: VS Code extension + local bridge that drives a logged-in web chat AI over CDP. Batches 0.1–7.1: bridge, CDP attach, RAM watchdog, three adapters, streaming panel, reviewable edits, project state, boot, guard, compression, settings, rotation, router, models, low-end mode.
